analysis.summary: In the Q1 FY27 earnings conference call, Akiko Global Services Limited reported growth in its core distribution business alongside the rollout of its hybrid fintech platform, AkikoPay. Management revised its FY27 revenue guidance upwards to between INR 325 crore and INR 350 crore, citing strong sourcing visibility and branch expansions. The company is targeting a PAT margin of 9% to 11% for the financial year while expanding its workforce. Management stated that current cash credit limits and bank arrangements are sufficient to fund growth, with no fundraise planned for the next 6 to 12 months. Akiko Global Services Limited reported strong financial performance for Q1 FY27, with revenue reaching ₹6,812.2 Lacs and EBITDA at ₹1,009.8 Lacs.

guidance.claim: Management revised its FY27 revenue guidance to between INR 325 crores and INR 350 crores.
guidance.quote: I am very comfortable to get INR325 crores to INR350 crores this FY27.

guidance.claim: Management expects to maintain a 70% to 100% year-on-year growth rate over the next three years.
guidance.quote: Because my vision is very clear for the next 3 years that our CAGR will remain the same at 70% to 100% year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: Management targets monthly loan disbursements reaching around INR 1,000 crores by December.
guidance.quote: Sir, our vision is that in this quarter, our employee count should reach 1,400 to 1,500, plus by December end, we will reach around INR1,000 crores disbursement.

guidance.claim: Management is confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability.
guidance.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

guidance.claim: Akiko Global Services expects revenue growth of 70% to 100% in FY27.
guidance.quote: I would like to give an outlook for FY27, which approximately I am expecting a target of 70% to 100% revenue growth, we have taken a minimum.

guidance.claim: Management targets FY27 revenue to be above INR 300 crores.
guidance.quote: Otherwise, I am expecting my outlook for 2027 is INR300 crores. That is not going below INR300 crores, this is going to be above INR300 crores.

guidance.claim: The company aims to reach INR 1,000 crores in revenue with PAT margins of 12% to 13% by 2030.
guidance.quote: We have a proper clear vision that we build INR1,000 crores revenue by 2030 and take PAT margins further to 12% to 13%.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q1 FY27 revenue to be between INR 65 crores and INR 70 crores.
guidance.quote: So let's see and I am looking forward for this quarter with good quarter numbers, INR65 crores to INR70 crores with good margins.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted strong bank partnerships and a healthy sourcing pipeline providing good visibility for upcoming quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: Bank partnerships are strong, and the sourcing pipeline is healthy, due to which we see good visibility for the upcoming quarters as well.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's core offline business and distribution are increasing month-on-month by 4% to 7%.
demand_outlook.quote: because our offline business, our core business, and our distribution are increasing month-on-month by 4% to 7%.

demand_outlook.claim: Personal loans are currently growing the fastest among all loan products.
The company has achieved a monthly loan disbursement run rate of over INR 400 crores, translating to an annual run rate of INR 5,000 crores.
demand_outlook.quote: Currently, we have reached a monthly disbursement run rate of INR400 crores+, which if we count annually, our book has become INR5,000 crores as of today.

demand_outlook.claim: Management aims to expand its unsecured loan book to INR 1,000 crores by the end of FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: By FY27, my target is INR1,000 crores of unsecured book.

capex_expansion.claim: The company operates 25 branches across 19 cities in India, all of which are leased.
capex_expansion.quote: In India, we have 25 branches. For DSAs, there are no separate ones because we don't do hard calling or hard selling under DSAs. So, we have 25 branches across 19 cities in India.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to open new branches in Indore and towards Kerala over the next two to three months.
capex_expansion.quote: Over the next 2-3 months, a couple of more branches are lined up, with one opening in Indore and one towards Kerala.

capex_expansion.claim: Integrating insurance and mutual fund services into AkikoPay will take 40 to 45 days.
capex_expansion.quote: From here, integration will take about 40 days -- 45 days. So, the visibility will be there.

capex_expansion.claim: The company continues to invest in technology, digital capabilities, and customer experience.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company continues to invest in technology, digital capabilities and customer experience while maintaining a disciplined approach towards scalable and profitable growth.

capex_expansion.claim: The rollout of the iOS version of AkikoPay is currently underway.
capex_expansion.quote: The iOS version is progressing as planned and is expected to offer a similar comprehensive experience in the coming months.

capex_expansion.claim: Akiko Global Services expanded its footprint to 16 branches across India.
capex_expansion.quote: I mean, where we had three or four branches in the last quarter, today we have 16 branches across India.

capex_expansion.claim: Total expenditure on building AkikoPay technology has been around INR 1 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Not much, around INR1 crores in total so far on building technology etc, that is it.

margins_costs.claim: Management is targeting a PAT margin of 9% to 11% for the current financial year.
margins_costs.quote: Sir, I am confident of 9% to 11% for this year. If AkikoPay works very well, next year that will go up to 12% to 14%.

margins_costs.claim: The company earns an average payout of 3.10% on its unsecured loan disbursements.
margins_costs.quote: First of all, within INR450 crores, all of this is unsecured. In unsecured, our average payout itself is 3.10%.

margins_costs.claim: Management emphasized maintaining profitability without cash burn.
margins_costs.quote: And we are heavily focused on staying profitable. Unlike other fintechs that burn money in their initial years, we are not focusing on losing money at all because our offline business, our core business, and our distribution are increasing month-on-month by 4% to 7%.

margins_costs.claim: The company delivered robust revenue growth while maintaining healthy profitability in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: The Company delivered robust revenue growth while maintaining healthy profitability, supported by sustained momentum across its credit card sourcing and lending businesses, reflecting the resilience of its diversified business model.

margins_costs.claim: AkikoPay operates with a disciplined cost structure and controlled operating burn.
margins_costs.quote: Disciplined cost structure with controlled operating burn

margins_costs.claim: AkikoPay achieves a 40% lower customer acquisition cost compared to traditional channels.
margins_costs.quote: Efficient Customer Acquisition: ~40% lower CAC vs traditional channels, enabled by a lean, digital-first model

margins_costs.claim: Investments in branch expansion and technology infrastructure impacted Q4 FY26 margins.
margins_costs.quote: This was due to our planned investment towards branch expansion, this was the most important thing, in which some of our money has been spent on that.

margins_costs.claim: Geopolitical issues in the Dubai/Iran region created temporary pressure on margins.
margins_costs.quote: And some of our margin pressure has come in Dubai operations, there has been temporary margin pressure due to the current geopolitical situation, as you all know, around the Iran region.

margins_costs.claim: The company's workforce comprises 486 employees and 430 field channel partners.
margins_costs.quote: The number I have given you is around 486 our employees and rest 430 are our channel partners in field who are commission agents.

orders_capacity.claim: The company currently employs 16 people in technology, around 700 in sales, 50 in backend, and 100 to 120 management staff.
orders_capacity.quote: Look, currently on the tech side, we have a total of 16 people -- 16 people on the tech side. On the sales side, we have odd 700 people. On the backend side, we have odd 50 people. And the rest are our management staff.

orders_capacity.claim: Management aims to scale total employee strength to between 1,400 and 1,500 in the current quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Sir, our vision is that in this quarter, our employee count should reach 1,400 to 1,500, plus by December end, we will reach around INR1,000 crores disbursement.

orders_capacity.claim: Monthly loan disbursements increased to over ₹450 crore, and monthly credit card sourcing scaled to 17,000–18,000 cards in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Operational execution remained strong during the quarter, with monthly loan disbursals increasing to over ₹450 crore, while monthly credit card sourcing scaled to 17,000–18,000 cards, driven by the Company's expanding distribution capabilities, technology-enabled customer acquisition platform, and deep banking and NBFC partnerships.

orders_capacity.claim: The company disburses more than 16,000 credit cards monthly.
orders_capacity.quote: If we talk about the credit card segment, which used to be our core business at one time, today we successfully disburse 16,000+ credit cards on a month-on-month basis.

orders_capacity.claim: Unsecured loans represent 80% of the company's book while secured loans account for 20%.
orders_capacity.quote: In secured, we are doing only 20% of business. In unsecured, we are doing 80% of business in our book.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has no plans to raise funds for the next 6 months to 1 year as existing credit limits are sufficient.
capital_allocation.quote: There is absolutely no plan for fundraising right now. Even banks are supporting us very well. So, our CC limits are well aligned. So, no need for any fundraising for the next 6 months or 1 year.

capital_allocation.claim: Receivable days decreased from 133 days to 110 days and are expected to drop below 90 days in Q2.
capital_allocation.quote: From 133 days, receivable days are coming down to 110 days. In Q2, I see receivable days coming down to within 90 days.

capital_allocation.claim: Management is committed to building AkikoPay without a cash-burn fintech model.
capital_allocation.quote: And one thing I would like to clearly say here, we are not building any cash-burn fintech model.

risks_headwinds.claim: Quarterly revenue from the Dubai business was limited to INR 1.25 crores due to war conditions in the region.
risks_headwinds.quote: In Dubai, due to war, our total revenue for the entire quarter was INR1.25 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's forward-looking statements are subject to known and unknown risks and uncertainties.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are not guarantees of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical situations surrounding the Iran region temporarily affected Dubai operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: And some of our margin pressure has come in Dubai operations, there has been temporary margin pressure due to the current geopolitical situation, as you all know, around the Iran region.

risks_headwinds.claim: AkikoPay experienced delayed launch on Apple's App Store due to compliance requirements.
risks_headwinds.quote: Right now, there was a compliance issue on the App Store for AkikoPay.
